Subject: Follow-up & next meeting: tech deep dive availability

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goal: validate latency/throughput for your reporting pipelines and confirm embedding strategy for search ranking.
- Key constraints you mentioned: existing VPC-only deployment, strict data retention controls, and procurement timeline targeting end of May.

Suggested next step: schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive where we can bring in platform and security to walk architecture, run a short performance sketch, and review any integration constraints. Proposed windows next week:
- Tue 4/20 9:30–10:30am PT
- Wed 4/21 2:00–3:00pm PT
- Thu 4/22 11:00am–12:00pm PT

If those don't work, send over two preferred slots and we will coordinate. I've looped in Marissa (solutions) for the tech dive and Soojin (security) to start the compliance thread — Marissa will own the demo logistics.

I attached a short mutual action plan draft and the SOC2 evidence checklist Sasha asked about — helpful to surface any gaps before the session.

Thanks — look forward to locking something in.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the recap and the MAP. 

Quick scheduling notes: Tue 4/20 at 9:30am PT looks good for our eng lead (Aisha) and me. Procurement is only available later in the week — I copied procurement here to coordinate if we need an overlapping slot for commercial questions.

Two asks before the call:
1) Can your security lead confirm whether Redwood can provide an on-prem connector or VPC peering details in the session?
2) We try to keep the first tech dive focused on architecture and perf; procurement prefers a separate short call for commercial terms — can we tentatively plan a 30-minute pricing/procurement sync on Fri 4/23?

If you can confirm Tue 4/20 9:30am PT I'll send an invite and include a short agenda.

Thanks,
Sasha
Director of Platform Engineering | FinLedger

Procurement — as Sasha mentioned, happy to keep the 60-minute technical session focused on architecture and perf; if it makes sense we can follow up with a separate 30-minute commercial call on Fri 4/23. I'll coordinate calendar invites once procurement confirms availability.

- 5–10m: intros and success criteria
- 20–25m: architecture + integration options (VPC/private deployment paths)
- 15m: perf sketch and expected throughput/latency tradeoffs
- 10m: open questions & next steps (covers procurement ask briefly)

If procurement can confirm Fri 4/23 for terms, please reply with preferred times.
